acceptanceCriteria: Observations carry an environment key with declared variant values; missing keys are reported unknown.
Two observations of one test at one tree SHA with different outcomes mark the claim flaky and downgrade qualification with the reason visible.
The JS-only flake logic is replaced by the shared rule with its existing tests kept green.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: flake detection exists only in the JS test provider and test observations carry no environment key. Add environment variant keys to test observations (ResultDB style) and a flake qualifier derived from divergent outcomes at the same tree SHA, applied uniformly across providers. Owning spec: docs/specs/test-claim-qualification-v0.md.
title: tcq: environment variants and same-SHA flake qualifier
